svg.title: Neuron session illustration
svg.desc: Animated illustration of a Neuron session: neuron login shows a device code, then the full-screen UI reads and edits a file, asks permission to run cargo test, and reports 14 passing tests.

g.text: Sign in to Zero-X to start Neuron.
The page is open in your browser; check that it shows the same code.
Waiting for approval (the code expires in 10 min; Ctrl+C to cancel)...
Signed in to Zero-X (plan free); session expires 2026-11-28 16:40 UTC. Login stored in the OS keychain.
Neuron will run commands on your behalf to help you build.
Add a test for expired tokens and fix whatever fails
I'll check how sessions expire, then add the test.
test result: ok. 14 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 0.02s
The expiry check compared with <= instead of <. I fixed it and added tests/expired_token.rs; all 14
enter a coding task or / for commands
Add a test for expired tokens and fix whatever fails
Run `cargo test auth`? Commands can change files and run programs, beyond what workspace-write allows.
esc deny · ctrl-c stop the turn
